extraction.name: MMStar
extraction.description: An elite vision-indispensable multi-modal benchmark comprising 1,500 samples meticulously selected by humans. MMStar benchmarks 6 core capabilities and 18 detailed axes, aiming to evaluate LVLMs' multi-modal capacities with carefully balanced and purified samples.
extraction.creator: Lin Chen, Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Zehui Chen, Haodong Duan, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao
extraction.publisher: University of Science and Technology of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Samples are first roughly selected from current benchmarks with an automated pipeline. Eight powerful LLMs are used as candidate inspectors for visual dependency and LLM leakage. Samples answered by more than 2 of the 8 LLMs are excluded. Then 16 leading LVLMs are used to gauge the difficulty of the samples and split them into four levels. Ultimately, strict manual review and selection are applied to curate 1,500 high-quality multimodal evaluation samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Samples were collected from existing multi-modal benchmarks: two focused on natural images (MMBench, SEED) and four centered on scientific and technical knowledge (MMMU, ScienceQA, AI2D, MathVista).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: An automated pipeline was developed to preliminarily filter out samples. Two closed-source LLMs and six open-source LLMs (sizing 20B or larger) served as inspectors. Samples with hit counts of two or fewer hits (meaning around 75% of LLM inspectors failed to provide the correct answer without visual input) were retained. The hit counts of 16 LVLMs were then tallied to split the coarsely filtered samples into four difficulty categories: easy, moderate, hard, and tough.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three experts conducted a manual review process to ensure: 1) each sample's answer should be based on the understanding of visual content; 2) selected samples should cover a comprehensive range of capability assessment dimensions; 3) most samples should require LVLMs to possess advanced multi-modal abilities for resolution.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT4-Turbo, GeminiPro, InternLM2-20B, Yi-34B, Mixtral-8x7B, Deepseek-67B, LLaMA2-70B, Qwen1.5-72B
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan to expand MMStar into a larger, online test set and explore dynamic evaluation methods to maintain sample visual dependency and reduce accidental data leakage into LLM's and LVLM's training corpora.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing and evaluating the actual multi-modal capacities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs).
